A. Baseline/package/database isolation: prove source/install realpaths belong to P3, guards refuse canonical production/non-loopback fixture targets, peer databases/ports remain untouched and primary index/source hashes are preserved. A distinct process with shared mutable package source does not pass.

B. Exact native result/lineage: ingest real permitted immutable fixture data, compile/execute existing native programme, independently check outputs/units/period/entity and every material ancestor. Challenge C_01/C_010, USD20/USD200, null/zero, ambiguous period/unit and a decisive source outside a bounded view. In the real private fixture app, two same-name records have those exact IDs; set C_01's fee to exactly USD20.00 and independently prove C_010's USD200.00 is unchanged. Exercise an explicitly supported nullable-field clear with decoded semantics; omitted/null/zero must not alias. Crash after the fixture backend accepts a change but before acknowledgement, retain its effect identity and independently read back or leave unknown without blind repeat. Fixture reconciliation never becomes production S6 settlement. Partial coverage refuses complete acceptance.

C. Equal-answer tenant attack: two different principals/tenants have equal inputs/results. Stolen handles, baseline refs, cache keys, checkpoint refs, result paths and signed request copies cannot be consumed cross-tenant. Foreign responses leak no counts/metadata/witnesses. Use actual ordinary DB/storage policy enforcement.

D. Dirty warm cell: put a prior tenant marker, private file, cookie, broker token or output in a cell, then attempt reassignment. Cleanliness check rejects/quarantines it. An unused public clean runtime can be shared only after an observable private-state/identity absence check.

E. OS escape/resource boundary: hostile code attempts host-file/socket/metadata access, symlink/archive traversal, spawn descendants/fork bomb, memory/storage/output exhaustion and indefinite execution. Actual Linux isolation/resource enforcement denies/terminates it, captures process-tree/cgroup observations and prevents late result publication. No mocks or environment scrubbing as a substitute.

F. Pure/app/simulation egress: attempt external DNS/direct IP/IPv6/redirect/WebSocket/background/navigation requests, including an apparently read-only URL with a consequential side effect. A separately observable disposable tripwire sees zero matching live effects from the cells. Positive controls establish that the observer can detect the exact attempts; no successful real lender request is required or authorized.

G. Mandatory three-financing-applications counterexample: three branch alternatives run a real fixture application with actual autosave/navigation/background/submit behavior and branch-private databases. They produce fixture-local state only. Attempts to reach a protected lender-like tripwire on autosave/navigation and final submit are all denied. Prove the protected observer remains unchanged across the whole lifecycle and each fixture’s state differs only within its branch. A firewall guarding just the final submit fails this test.

H. Fixture cloning/restoration: cold baseline and two independent mutable clones; write files/rows and active app state in one, verify baseline/other branch unchanged, interrupt actual processes, restore a consistent supported checkpoint into a fresh identity and compare complete declared state. Incompatible/open inconsistent snapshots refuse rather than silently reset data.

I. Snapshot trust/compatibility: mutate a byte in image/module/memory/disk/manifest, use wrong CPU/architecture/runtime/schema/key/rights, insert stale/embedded private credentials or mix state files from different checkpoints. Restore refuses/quarantines; costs and rejected object identities remain recorded. No CRC-only authentication.

J. Crash publication matrix: kill before launch, after launch intent, during execution, during checkpoint file write, after durable blob/before DB pointer, after DB pointer/before acknowledgement, during independent checking, after result commit and before request acknowledgement. Restart real worker/controller; assert one current accepted result, no duplicate accounting/false settlement, accurate attempt lineage and discoverable cleanup/recovery obligations.

K. Lease loss/late worker: expire or invalidate the real resource/job fence while an invocation runs; a successor receives a new fence; the old process aborts and cannot publish/checkpoint/settle/release the successor’s lease. Test capacity deferral without consuming a logical attempt and foreground reserve/per-tenant cap with actual contention.

L. Cancellation/revocation: cancel during prepare/run/checkpoint/check/publication; revoke rights or funding and change Work/source/programme revision. Capture observed process-tree teardown, refused late outputs/reads/resumes and exact partial usage/cost. Cancellation acknowledgement alone is not success.

M. S3 simulation fidelity: actual owner model/prepared references and joint scenarios; matched seed reproduces the supported model-relative outputs within the frozen tolerance; correlated shocks/non-anticipation/domain limits remain visible. Wrong model/regime/transport support fails. No causal/world claim arises from repeatability.

N. S6 live-read: actual reviewed broker adapter with a disposable permitted source, exact operation/target/actor/rights and bounded observation. Attempts to change target, method, amount, actor, principal, egress scope or turn a read into an autosave/write are refused. Interrupted external attempts retain owner reconciliation status; stale replay is historical, not a new observation.

O. Checker corruption: candidate modifies postconditions, check result, output/state-delta digest, evidence class, measured costs or acceptance/settlement field. The independent consumer/checker detects and rejects it. A checker timeout/outage/incomplete oracle leaves unresolved acceptance, not a default pass.

P. Cache/currentness: valid reuse under same principal/domain/current cut; source membership, document binding/archive, rights, Work, model, programme, schema/runtime or prior-result changes invalidate material descendants. Equal numerical output never justifies stale or cross-tenant reuse. Unaffected valid preparation may remain reusable with a recorded reason.

Q. Resume accounting: kill an interruptible job and resume/restart with exact immutable inputs; all original/preparation/failed/resumed/checking/storage costs remain once-only. Exhausted total budget stops admission and keeps a truthful partial incumbent. Missing money/memory/external-cost meters keep relevant gates unpassed.

R. Branch comparison/continuation: compare only matched baselines/domain/check/accounting scopes; partial/refused branches stay in the record. Attempt replay of fixture credentials/request transcript or stale authority as a live financing application; actual S6 boundary refuses. A fresh continuation requires actual S4/S5/S6 owner authority and is not executed by this fixture test.

S. Work/API/UI: actual authenticated prepare→async run→check→read/compare→witness→checkpoint/resume/cancel→reload/return flow. Foreign/principal-switched and expired tokens refuse. Material Work edit clears old numeric results. Measure acknowledgement and preserve evidence class/pending/isolation/cost states. Use actual signed local test authority where supported and record its fixture qualification; production bypass remains denied.

T. Real sibling joins when available: actual P4 finite derivation consumed in P3, source/rights/Work revocation propagates; actual M1 current slice bound to branch input cut and invalidated on material change; late/cancelled cross-producer outputs do not populate new Work. A decoding mock only passes decoding, not these cases.

1. **Unsupplied structure and term generation.** Supply primitive signatures, supported term domain, mandate/models/resources and an incumbent, while withholding the solution graph and successful term tuple. Require actual construction of a supported economic structure and parameter combination absent from the supplied alternatives. Independently compare compiled semantics/module/owner policy and resulting consequences. Renamed supplied candidates, a hidden fixture-to-answer lookup or prose-only proposal fail. Preserve a second instance with different identities/coefficients/topology to expose overfitting.

2. **Incumbent stays best.** Include permitted new staged/financing/inquiry structures whose fees, delay, resource occupation or response risk make them worse. The producer must retain the original qualified incumbent and explain the supported comparison/gap without inventing a novel winner. Independently verify equal-value ties use frozen lawful tie behavior. Reject a novelty bonus, silent objective change, omitted declined offer or claimed improvement from rounding a tie.

3. **Observable histories and hidden worlds.** Create two supported worlds with different latent states but identical available observations at an early decision time. Independent traversal must show the same early action. Later genuine separating observations may permit different actions only at their availability time. Inject a graph branching on mechanism/world ID or future state; refuse it before dependent use, even if its model value looks better. Record the first violated information-equivalence predicate and affected nodes.

4. **Staged payment on an unobservable milestone.** Construct an attractive second tranche conditional on an unsupported future event or forecast-only metric. Require a real supported observation contract or exact blocker; no release action appears in a live eligible branch. Also test a lawful delayed milestone whose arrival misses the funding deadline. More model confidence cannot make it observable, and waiting cannot extend a real deadline without agreement/mandate support.

5. **Agreement, amendment and waiver.** Propose refinancing that requires a covenant waiver or changed-price acceptance. Refuse treating unagreed terms as current funding/effects. Then test explicit rejected, expired, delayed, superseded or contradictory agreement evidence under S1 standing/currentness. A prior agreement for another amount/entity/period cannot authorize the new proposal. Exact operative amendment chain, authorized parties and required observation remain material; a signature-shaped blob or model-generated acceptance is insufficient.

6. **Changed intervention changes response.** Use competing supported S3 mechanisms in which staging, disclosure or changed financing alters counterparty/customer response. Recompute joint trajectories rather than carrying the immediate-plan coefficients/probability unchanged. Include out-of-support doses/context/regime and incomplete identification. Independent reference checks which model assumption changed, the domain/refusal and whether candidate value can legitimately be compared. Do not relabel simulated strategy as measured human response.

7. **Information sequence versus action-only choice.** In a supported finite case a real inquiry arriving before deadline changes feasible later actions; in another its delay/cost/reactivity makes it useless or unsupported. Require actual S2 protocol/mechanism/utility/exposure/currentness binding and included full cost. A generated question/answer does not supply a likelihood law. The independent oracle respects controller information, samples/missingness and delayed arrival; do not use clairvoyant per-world best actions as the reference policy.

8. **Same-deal mutually exclusive arrangements.** Generate several structures for one transaction. The joint selected portfolio must respect the actual choice constraint and cannot count multiple incompatible acquisitions or independently share the same asset/payoff. Independently enumerate selections including the empty portfolio and existing commitments. A description-level deduplication alone is insufficient; the canonical S5 problem/check must contain the economic exclusivity.

9. **Concurrent mandates and shared capital.** Race two real Works against one S5 pool/current snapshot. Candidate evaluation is pure; selected reservations serialize under the actual owner. At most the jointly feasible commitments clear, with loser retaining the current reason/incumbent. Verify durable registry/reservation/consumption rows, replay and revalidation after another reservation. Reject check-then-write races, per-Work artificial cash copies and an expired reservation incorrectly freeing unknown exposure.

10. **Occupancy, maturity and negative covariance terms.** Exercise per-period occupancy and cumulative/stock/flow differences, debt maturity/interest/minimum cash, tail obligations and shared covenant coefficients with negative terms. Independently verify the appropriate simultaneous upper/lower usage and full horizon. A cash quantity cannot become borrowing headroom, future uncertain proceeds cannot fund today's tranche, and a cash-in/cash-out net cannot hide peak exposure. Unsupported financial maturity/refinancing mechanics remain explicit.

11. **Fees, units and accounting conservation.** Change offer/financing parameters at decimal boundaries and verify sources/uses, principal/interest/distributions/ownership/cash/fees and output units using a separate exact financial oracle where supported. Test USD20.00 versusUSD200.00, percent versus decimal rate, million versus unit, wrong entity/consolidation/calendar/currency and undefined/multiple-root return cases. Finite FLOAT64 value calculations must not override exact S5 resource feasibility or turn an unknown number into0.

12. **Original40-million decision example.** Preserve `V_immediate(p)=18−50p` and modeled incumbent3, all in millions on one horizon/accounting basis; threshold0.30, endpoints13 at0.10 and−12 at0.60, tie at0.30. Independently check the arithmetic. New staged/changed-offer payoffs and response require their own declared model; do not derive them by multiplying the original immediate payoff by a tranche ratio. These hypothetical values establish no market forecast or calibrated p, and current robust S4 does not average them without an admitted probability semantics.

13. **Remote operative clause and decision coverage.** Place a decisive change-of-control clause/amendment far from the financial summary and require its dependency or unresolved evidence demand. Actual M1 DECISION use refuses material legal/response gaps even if NUMERICAL_ONLY succeeds. Read real witnesses and complete permitted handles; a selected-universe or bounded-tail omission cannot certify absence. New terms must widen the relevant closure when financing/collateral/authority changes. Do not merely assert that a document title appears in context.

14. **Joint sensitivity and inactive conditional arms.** Use a joint product/threshold with zero one-variable marginal sensitivity and an inactive fallback arm that becomes material under new terms. Fresh M1 closure retains interacting variables and both conditional arms. Tamper the independent projection witness/graph/digest and require rejection. No caller loss budget, feature importance score or projectionLoss:null cast authorizes removing a material dependency. Show the changed arrangement's actual decision impact under the declared model.

15. **Authentic P4 material input.** Acquire actual handles, submit through the actual registered job/queue, execute/check and read the owner derivation; bind typed financial output to native calculation/M1. Test failed division/unsupported operator, period/entity/currency mismatch, contradictory sources and debt restatement. A failed/partial derivation supplies no successful scalar. Record original P4 acquisition/invocation/recovery receipts as upstream costs once, and prove stale read/witness refusal without serving corrected data under an old digest.

16. **Work revision and code/schema change.** Let real evidence submission advance Work input while M3 is running, and add a genuine changed method/schema in a controlled fixture. The old M3/M1/P4 bindings invalidate before publication or use; recompile/rederive on the exact new cut. Do not patch P4's broad code/schema checks or mix old numerical output with fresh citations. Include an unrelated root change that preserves an unaffected candidate to verify dependency precision instead of indiscriminate global refresh.

17. **Recursive method actually executes.** Give a supported abstract native subproblem absent from the preset economic procedure. Require bounded refinement, typecheck/compiler diagnostics, actual emitted/interpreted bytes executed through the real available boundary, and independent result comparison. Remove the synthesis/refinement mechanism with an executable substitution; the previously unsupported composition cannot magically succeed. A static helper or generated source never invoked cannot pass. Unsupported primitives/isolation become exact pending predicates with no fabricated result.

18. **Hostile/invalid generated proposal and module.** Inject cyclic/oversized/deep AST, undeclared variables, wrong dimensional algebra, future knowledge, arbitrary imports/code/tool URL/SQL, side-effect commands and forged owner refs. Reject at bounded decoding/typing/owner/module boundaries before execution. Exercise actual process/environment/egress restrictions for the selected backend and unsupported required quota refusal; a test that only examines a profile string proves no confinement. Worker output remains untrusted until checked.
